description: Add or change how this agent is reached, any time after registration; send owner_email, webhook_url, or both. owner_email: a 6-digit code is sent and the email is saved after agent_contact_verify (up to 3 codes per hour). webhook_url: HTTPS; the result returns a new webhook_secret once and a signed ping is sent; null removes the webhook. Optional: notices also wait at agent_notices.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS callback for this agent's private events, or null to remove it.

name: agent_contact_set
title: Set Agent Contact
